definitions: A proposed floating city, designed to be a permanent residence for a large community, continuously circumnavigating the globe.
A conceptual mega-ship project envisioned as a mobile, self-sufficient community with residential, commercial, and recreational facilities.
examples: The Freedom Ship project aimed to create a new way of life at sea.
Many were skeptical about the feasibility of the Freedom Ship.
The Freedom Ship would have its own infrastructure, including power generation and waste management.
